timing.same_time_order: PD/control cycle publishes state and applies previous available output; inference; physical stepping; new output first consumed at next PD tick.
timing.difference_from_interactive: Interactive program uses independent wall-clock threads and GUI-paced physics. This diagnostic uses deterministic simulation-time ordering. No wall-clock jitter or real-time slowdown equivalence is claimed.
timing.float32_periods: Exact float32 runtime values retained above; event schedule reads YAML decimal dt as double. No dt/decimation/XML option was changed.

reset.physics: mj_resetDataKeyframe(home_leg), then mj_forward, as R handler in rl_sim_LW.cpp
reset.policy: fresh process/core per case; invoke existing RLFSMStateRLLocomotion_Leg.Enter through StateController; first inference initializes history with first frame repeated 10 times
reset.startup_difference: Direct policy FSM activation at reset pose; interactive Passive/GetUp operator path and its interpolation time are not exercised.
reset.mid_episode: none; native R handler resets physics but does not by itself reset runtime history; not modified or exercised here
reset.seed_method: std::srand(42) before reset; deterministic ONNX; no added randomization

disturbance.interactive_input: not created; deterministic command hook used
disturbance.sensor_noise_fields: jointactuatorfrc noise=0.01 retained in compiled model; full sensors and enableflags recorded; no independent stochastic sensor-noise calibration performed
disturbance.external_force_evidence: all pre/post xfrc_applied and qfrc_applied recorded and checked

frames.base: base_link; freejoint transform is body-to-world wxyz; IMU site is identity relative to base_link
frames.forward: body +X treated as policy forward, +Y left, +Z up; supported by deployment command convention and observed +vx displacement; no independent mesh-front calibration asset supplied
frames.visual: base mesh attached to base_link with no source MJCF pose offset; compiled geom pose includes MuJoCo mesh centering/principal-axis transform, retained in effective.geoms
frames.pitch: R=Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll); raw pitch=asin(-R[2,0]); backward_lean=-pitch; roll=atan2(R[2,1],R[2,2]); report degrees
frames.gravity: R_body_to_world.T @ normalize(world_gravity). Distinguish full precision current freejoint from float32 runtime IMU sensor quaternion.
frames.raw_telemetry_velocity_clarification: Original pre/post.base_linear_velocity_world/body are mj_objectVelocity(mjOBJ_BODY) at body COM, not freejoint origin. Keep these immutable. Canonical base-origin linear velocities are in telemetry_derived.jsonl.gz (join by case_id/control_step). This offset is verified numerically as omega_world cross (R @ body_ipos).
frames.angular_velocity: original pre/post.base_angular_velocity_world/body are explicit frames; policy angular velocity is float32 imu gyro in body/site frame

action.formula: a=clip(raw_action, lower, upper); for nonwheels q_target=q_default+scale*a,dq_target=0; for wheels q_target=q_default,dq_target=scale*a; runtime inference PD estimate=Kp*(q_target-q_obs)+Kd*(dq_target-dq_obs); FSM sends feedforward_tau=0; at each PD tick candidate=feedforward+Kp*(q_target-q_sensor)+Kd*(dq_target-dq_sensor); ctrl[actuator_id]=clip(candidate,+/-torque_limits); MuJoCo motor uses gear=1 with ctrlrange.
action.modes: 8 joints position PD; 2 wheels velocity PD (Kp=0). All XML actuators are motor torque controls.
action.warning: Runtime mapping is preserved, not corrected. User supplied Isaac telemetry order differs; actual training action indexing/config was not locally available for independent verification.

fields.field: q-q_default; wheel positions forcibly represented as 0 by existing observation code
previous clipped action; zero at activation

observations.history: time-major 10x41 oldest to newest; indices [9..0]; latest input slice [369:410]; first frame repeated 10 times, then insertion before every forward
observations.gait: float32 phase += policy_period*gait_frequency before observation; wrap at 1; moving=norm(command)>0.1; phase advances during zero command, output sin/cos gated to zero
observations.clip: all 41 values clipped to +/-100 before history insertion
observations.normalization: runtime only scales/clips fields, no running-stat normalization. Archived matching JIT wrapper declares actor_obs_normalizer Identity; archive states training observation normalization disabled. Loaded ONNX internals independently enumerated in onnx_graph.json.
observations.recurrent_state: external interface has only obs and actions; no explicit recurrent state or reset mask

telemetry.precision: JSON round-trip decimal representation of float64 and float32 values, gzip lossless; no smoothing/rounding/downsampling
telemetry.control_step: policy inference index, zero-based; each row contains all 4 PD callbacks and all 10 physics steps
telemetry.pre: full-precision state at inference boundary before PD callback; read-only mj_forward on scratch copy computes coherent derived kinematics/contacts
telemetry.policy_state_float32: exact float32 values read by existing adapter from original sensor data; evaluation is normally one physical substep before current qpos, except initial reset
telemetry.model_raw_action: output copied immediately from underlying ONNX forward before runtime action clipping
telemetry.new_policy_targets: new output computed this row, not necessarily applied at first PD callback of row
telemetry.low_level_updates: each actual delivered PD target/ctrl with nominal and actual simulation times and applied policy frame
telemetry.physics_substeps: each integration interval: ctrl and force from that interval; post_qpos/qvel at its end
telemetry.post: state after all recorded physics substeps; last_dynamics forces belong to the final integration interval
telemetry.contact_force: mj_contactForce on refreshed scratch data at recorded boundary; constraint diagnostic, not foot force sensor wrench
telemetry.foot_height: foot site origin heights only; exact sole-bottom height not derived from mesh

termination.diagnostic: nonfinite qpos/qvel; any MuJoCo warning; core terminal/fallback; base origin z<0.25m; upright-axis tilt>75deg; base collision contact; simulation time reset; program exception

experiment.on_failure: preserve logs, stop the affected case, no tuning or retry
experiment.unchanged: model, XML, physics (including freejoint frictionloss=.2), action mapping, PD, scaling, normalization, history algorithm, seed, reset/FSM path, scheduling and action delay

measurement_notes.linear_velocity: base_origin_* at freejoint/body origin; base_com_* at inertial COM; explicit world/body frames
measurement_notes.pre: current integration boundary; policy_state/observation_frame raw_q uses native named sensor evaluation at previous physical substep (except reset)
measurement_notes.snapshot: input/frame/state synchronously copied before underlying model forward; completed row persisted after physics; pending row retained on exception
measurement_notes.yaw_rate: body omega_z and world omega_z recorded separately; heading derivative=(sin(roll)*omega_body_y+cos(roll)*omega_body_z)/cos(pitch)
measurement_notes.noise: joint_pos observation noise off for both conditions; this isolates zero-mask semantics, not full noisy Isaac observations
measurement_notes.units: q rad, dq/omega rad/s, velocity m/s, torque N*m; observation inputs are float32 and raw MuJoCo state is float64
measurement_notes.oscillation: per-joint raw std plus residual std after removing a fitted linear trend; pooled RMS over 8 non-wheel joints; action increments over adjacent samples within window
measurement_notes.fall: same diagnostic thresholds as original collector; no retry; time_limit is normal termination
measurement_notes.reset: each process home_leg + original direct Leg FSM Enter; first history filled with own condition frame; no intermediate physical reset in four runs
measurement_notes.source_reference_caveat: previous report order uncertainty is superseded by user verified actual policy-input/action order; source reference describes historical run only
